printers.name: Name
printers.showGuide: How do I connect a Bambu Lab printer? (show guide)
printers.guideStep1: On the printer's touchscreen: open Settings → WiFi/Network and note the displayed IP address.
printers.guideStep2: In the same menu, turn on "LAN Mode" (LAN Only Mode / LAN Mode Liveview) — depending on the model this is under network or general settings.
printers.guideStep3: In the same menu, show and note the 8-character access code.
printers.guideStep4: Find the serial number under Settings → Device info, or on the printer's nameplate.
printers.guideStep5: Enter all four values (name is up to you, IP address, serial number, access code) below in "New printer".
